purpose: Executed teaching controls, not new biological experiments or a learner mastery certificate

inspect.input: assets/3wd5.pdb; first model, selected positive-occupancy protein heavy atoms
inspect.missing: Neither full IgG nor the complete biological TNF trimer

translation_control.interpretation: Same conformation; translation changes raw RMSD, not centered RMSD or Rg.

oscillator_small_step.system: One dimensionless harmonic oscillator; not molecular dynamics of a protein

oscillator_large_step_equal_time.system: One dimensionless harmonic oscillator; not molecular dynamics of a protein

graph_control.selection: 3WD5 chain A, positive-occupancy CA; |author residue numbers| > 1
graph_control.interpretation: Geometric contact graph, not an energy or causal network

limitations: The oscillator is dimensionless and not a protein.
CA Rg uses equal weights, not all-atom masses.
Graph degree describes the chosen geometric threshold, not energy.
The survey evidence extraction remains in progress.
